summary: --select recognises field names in rows nested through several arrays, so `commissione dossier --select titolo` and `novita --select titolo` filter the rows instead of reporting the field as missing.
reason: topLevelKeys looked one array level below the root while filterFieldsRec descends through every array, so the warning contradicted the output on `sezioni[].risultati[]`.
validated_outcome: Live: `commissione dossier 5 --select titolo` and `novita --select titolo` keep only `titolo` in rows with no warning; `pippo` still warns and prints the full payload. Old and new binaries match on 18 --select cases across `ddl get`, `ddl iter`, `ddl stralci`, `legge cronologia`, `deputato profilo`, `resoconti get`, `interrogazioni get`, `interrogazioni cerca` and `gruppi get`, apart from the cache-busting timestamp in `ddl get` URLs.
